evals.name: init-project
evals.prompt: I just opened up the Schedules folder for a new project — W9990 Salt Flats Test Temple — and want to set it up. Initialize the project context with: contractual completion 2028-03-15, SmartPM workspace https://live.smartpmtech.com/projects/saltflats/workspace, signer Camron Walker (Scheduler), Procore project ID 5550000. TO recipients: Morne Wilken <mwilken@westlandconstruction.com>; Trent Christensen <tchristensen@westlandconstruction.com>. CC: Camron Walker <camron@westlandconstruction.com>. Use the Westland default graph list. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}.
evals.expected_output: A project-context.html file written into the Schedules folder with all the supplied values. The file must be created via generate_project_context_html.py — never via Write/Edit on raw HTML.
expectations: project-context.html exists in the Schedules folder
The agent invoked generate_project_context_html (the canonical generator)
The agent did NOT use the Edit tool on project-context.html
The agent did NOT use the Write tool to author project-context.html directly (Write is fine if the agent saves a Python script, just not the HTML itself)
The final HTML round-trips cleanly through parse_project_context_html
The signer name 'Camron Walker' appears in the parsed values
The Procore project ID '5550000' appears in the parsed values

evals.name: update-signer
evals.prompt: Update the signer on this project's context to Camron Walker, Scheduler. Mobile is +1 801.555.0199. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}. project-context.html already exists there.
evals.expected_output: project-context.html with signer_name='Camron Walker', signer_title='Scheduler', signer_mobile='+1 801.555.0199'. All other fields preserved exactly. The change must go through parse → mutate dict → generate. No direct Edit/Write on the HTML file.
expectations: The agent invoked parse_project_context_html (read-side of CRUD)
The agent invoked generate_project_context_html (write-side of CRUD)
The agent did NOT use the Edit tool on project-context.html
The agent did NOT use the Read tool on project-context.html
The signer_name in the resulting file equals 'Camron Walker'
The signer_title in the resulting file equals 'Scheduler'
Recipients, SmartPM URLs, and graph list are preserved unchanged from the seed
